finding.message: Claim C2 declared required_support=3 while its evidence graph contained two supporting artifact edges.
finding.resolution: Set required_support to 2 because verification-summary.json already aggregates the algebra, dense/factorized, symmetry, and compatibility checks, while cuda-smoke-v2.1.json supplies the independent finite CUDA execution record. No scientific result or evidence edge changed.
finding.residual_risk: required_support is a sidecar evidence-count contract, not a count of independent scientific replications.
